question:
Which of the following numbers will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

96, 90, ?, 60, 36, 6
solution:
**Logic :** Consecutive multiples of (6) are subtracted from the given series. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5665b0868b86c4c12df1a8ba301a1422d2df164d0e7634195d1c6b353a208a74.png] 

Hence, **"78"** is the correct answer.
